svg.title: Initialize one repository: choose the matching route
svg.desc: Greenfield and brownfield are alternatives, not consecutive phases. Each has its own entry, scope and terminal result. Read the companion guide for conditions and all output details.

svg.text: INITIALIZATION • TWO ALTERNATIVES, NOT ONE SEQUENCE

svg.text: Alternative 1: Initialize a new project from intent

svg.title: Initialize a new project from intent
svg.desc: Choose this route only when meaningful source does not yet exist. A decomposition persona is not an extra agent dispatch. Existing source selects the separate brownfield route. Actual endpoint: Five source-bound context/provenance pairs, three confirmed project-level documents, retained interview evidence and native initialization. Continue already-authorized work; population alone does not prove implementation or verification. Conditions and return paths remain in the companion reading view.

svg.desc: skill: decompose: populate project context → skill: decompose: native finalization. Five paired v2 context documents, the task/question boards, audit header and native initialization result. Retained interview evidence supports intended design; observed implementation facts remain distinct.

path.title: inspect then finalize: Finalize only against current output identities and retained evidence. Remove temporary drafts only when no provenance source refers to them.

g.title: decompose: populate project context. Prepare each of five context drafts from retained interview sources. Use --context-draft and apply its exact preview with --context-apply to commit the document and v2 provenance together. Use taskwrite.py for backlog entries and decision-lifecycle for actual ADR choices.

g.title: decompose: native finalization. Run --context-finalize against all thirteen required outputs, inspect the result and apply its exact preview. The writer commits the initialization marker with matching provenance. Read back the result and retain plans/decomposition source records; recover an uncertain transaction before retrying.

svg.text: Alternative 2: Initialize existing code from evidence

svg.title: Initialize existing code from evidence
svg.desc: Choose this route when meaningful source exists. Initial or full work covers six logical categories through direct bounded inspection or optional scoped agents; scoped refreshes cover only declared affected categories through context-check. Actual host permissions and excluded paths apply. An agent label does not prove containment or semantic correctness. Actual endpoint: Populated source-backed project state, provenance and a code map. Material user-owned questions retain actual resolutions or explicit deferrals; other unknowns remain visible with their inspected scope. It does not invent the three greenfield planning documents. Conditions and return paths remain in the companion reading view.

text.font-family: JetBrains Mono Variable, Consolas, Cascadia Mono, monospace
Manrope Variable, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Scaffold → inspect bounded source → preview and apply → initialize

svg.title: Inspect bounded source evidence
svg.desc: command: /ca:init: scaffold once → command: /ca:create-context: selected strategy → skill: context-creation: confirm the source → skill: context-creation: direct or delegated inspection. Initial/full work accounts for all six categories with inspected evidence and explicit unknowns. Scoped refresh retains the declared affected coverage; missing reports can be resolved through direct inspection.

validate source shape: The skill validates its own preconditions.
bounded inspection: Inspect the selected source directly or delegate finite assignments within actual host permissions.

g.title: /ca:init: scaffold once. Create the enabled stub only when absent. Select the existing-code populator rather than treating the activation flag as completed initialization.

g.title: context-creation: confirm the source. Confirm meaningful code, an uninitialized context and primary source directories. Check actual host permissions before reading; ordinary work does not require a special scout profile.

g.title: context-creation: direct or delegated inspection. Inspect stack, infrastructure, architecture, security, testing and data model for initial/full work; scoped refresh covers affected categories. Optional agents receive finite assignments within host limits. Retain citations, source identities, conflicts and unknowns without secret values.

svg.title: Resolve the evidence gaps
svg.desc: skill: context-creation: source-backed synthesis → skill: context-creation: resolve or defer → skill: context-creation: write project state. Real values come from cited inspection and actual owner decisions. Uncertainty remains visible; independent solvable work need not wait for unrelated gaps.

path.title: missing facts: Only the needed user facts are asked, not a second greenfield interview.
resolved or deferred: Apply supported claims and actual decisions while preserving human content, protected owners and explicit unknowns.

g.title: context-creation: source-backed synthesis. Map inspected evidence into context, stack, standards, security and code-map drafts. Reinspect disputed or changed sources directly or with an independent agent when useful; do not turn an inferred claim into a verified fact.

text.font-family: JetBrains Mono Variable, Consolas, Cascadia Mono, monospace

g.title: context-creation: resolve or defer. Ask only missing material user-owned decisions. Record actual resolutions or explicit deferrals through the question owner. Real unresolved prerequisites stop dependent work; unrelated uncertainty stays visible without blocking independent work.

text.font-family: JetBrains Mono Variable, Consolas, Cascadia Mono, monospace
Manrope Variable, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif

g.title: context-creation: write project state. Prepare the five content documents with context-preview, inspect the exact diff and source bindings, then apply preview_ref and preview_sha256 under existing authorization. No per-document approval receipt is required. Board mutations retain their own helper; a release-target row remains conditional on real evidence or a resolved declaration.
